title: Reliance Plans $1.3 Billion Bond in First Sale Since 2023
summary: Billionaire Mukesh Ambani’s Reliance Industries Ltd. is planning to raise as much as 125 billion rupees ($1.3 billion) via local-currency bonds as early as next week, according to people familiar with the matter, which would make it the largest listed deal in the market this year.

title: Global Bond Rush Kicks Off in Asia With Banks Leading the Charge
summary: Borrowers from around the Asia Pacific stormed the dollar bond market on Tuesday, unleashing one of the busiest sessions of the year in the region, as companies across the globe are primed to tap investors in force before interest rates go any higher.

title: Yen's Fundamentals 'Different This Time Around,' Natixis Says
summary: There is room for a "lot of movement" for the yen, according to Trinh Nguyen, senior economist for emerging Asia at Natixis. "The reshoring of not just Japanese investors, the hiking of interest rates, and also on top of that, the fact that JGB yields are very, very attractive and the yen is undervalued,"  Nguyen explains. "All these factors I think means that this time it really is different." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Bridgepoint Credit Sells €1.2 Billion Loan Portfolio to Pantheon
summary: Bridgepoint Credit has transferred €1.2 billion ($1.4 billion) of loans from an older direct-lending fund into a new continuation vehicle, according to a statement seen by Bloomberg.

title: High-Speed Trader AlphaGrep Turns to Bonds After India Bank Curb

title: Yen Advances to Six-Month High, Crude Oil Climbs: Markets Wrap
